title: Desambiguación pragmática de las funciones de se
goal: Disambiguate among reflexive, reciprocal, inchoative, and passive meanings of the multi-functional pronoun 'se'.
grammar: desambiguación contextual y pragmática de los valores reflexivo, recíproco y pasivo de se

items: Distinguish reciprocal interpretations from passive reflexives in plural animated contexts.
Differentiate pronominal aspectual nuances from true passive structures.
Analyze ambiguous sentences and restructure them for crystal-clear clarity.
